notes:
User is planning fitness and sports schedules. They are training for an upcoming charity 5K and hope to beat their personal best of 25:50. They are interested in endurance, pacing, interval training, running form, recovery, fueling, and strength work for running. Core and leg strengthening has improved both running and soccer.

During intervals, they asked whether to prioritize finishing hard or holding consistent pacing. Guidance given: use controlled hard efforts, avoid sacrificing form, start slightly conservatively, keep work/recovery intervals consistent, and prioritize recovery between efforts. Recommended strength exercises include planks, Russian twists, leg raises, squats, lunges, glute bridges, calf raises, step-ups, deadlifts, toe curls, ankle circles, and single-leg balance; suggested 2–3 sessions weekly with at least a rest day between sessions, warm-up/cool-down, and moderate weights/higher reps initially.

User also plays tennis recreatively and plans to enter a tournament on May 6. Their goal is to reach at least the quarterfinals. Preparation focuses on serving, volleys, footwork, returns, consistency, and equipment. For the serve, they are particularly focused on improving toss consistency. Practice toss-and-catch, toss-and-hold, toss-and-move, visualization, and partner toss drills, initially around 6–8 feet high, gradually increasing difficulty while emphasizing repeatable placement and timing.

Racket/string guidance previously discussed: beginner/intermediate casual players generally benefit from a comfortable, maneuverable, forgiving racket; control-oriented players often prefer a smaller head, while power-oriented players may prefer a larger head. String choice balances control, power, feel, durability, and spin; lower tension generally gives more power, higher tension more control. Demoing equipment is preferable.

User plays soccer with coworkers; exact next soccer game date/time is unconfirmed, and no calendar access is available. They recently scored in a recreational game despite not typically being a goal scorer and are interested in shooting/finishing improvement.
